title: Smoking Health Risk Analytics Dashboard
tagline: Synthetic smoking patterns, health-risk indicators, and organ-wise analytics
overview: Designed a Power BI healthcare analytics project using a carefully controlled 30,000-row synthetic, risk-enriched screening cohort. The project analyzes smoking status, age, gender, blood pressure, cholesterol, lifestyle patterns, and illustrative organ-risk indicators across Human Body, Heart, Lungs, Liver, and Kidney views. The dashboard is created for educational analytics only; Healthy/Damaged labels and risk scores are synthetic indicators, not medical diagnoses or national population prevalence.
objectives: Track core healthcare analytics KPIs including Total Patients, Smoking Status Distribution, Average Risk Score, Blood Pressure Profile, and Cholesterol Profile
Analyze Never, Current, and Former smoking patterns across age groups, gender, lifestyle habits, and synthetic health-risk indicators
Compare smoking exposure and illustrative risk patterns across Human Body, Heart, Lungs, Liver, and Kidney analysis cohorts
Build an interactive Power BI experience using organ navigation, Healthy/Damaged state selection, dynamic anatomy visuals, and DAX-based organ filtering
Explore relationships between smoking behavior, physical activity, alcohol use, blood pressure, cholesterol, BMI, and synthetic risk scores
key_insights: The final synthetic cohort contains 30,000 patient records distributed unevenly across five organ-analysis cohorts for more realistic dashboard comparison
Never smokers account for 46.17% of the cohort, while Current smokers account for 32.22% and Former smokers account for 21.62%
The Lungs cohort has the highest Current smoker share at 37%, making it the strongest smoking-exposure comparison view
The Liver cohort has the highest Never smoker share at 48% and the lowest Current smoker share at 29%
Healthy and Damaged states are balanced at a 60/40 split within every Organ and Smoking Status group, preventing the Healthy view from becoming overly dominated by Never smokers
Every age group contains meaningful Current and Former smoker records, ensuring complete age-wise smoking analysis
github_description: Synthetic healthcare analytics project using 30K patient records to analyze smoking status, lifestyle factors, blood pressure, cholesterol, age groups, gender, and organ-wise illustrative risk indicators in Power BI.
